claim: Sony's LPEC reference implementation (LPEC.dll from Digital Voice Editor 3.3.01) is obtained and statically analyzed at census level: full C++ codec API mapped, decode entry chain identified, codec confirmed CELP-family (per-frame pitch lag + codebook page index), and the complete per-mode codebook table inventory extracted (two table sets selected by sample rate 8000/16000 Hz, with bitrate 6000 bps special-cased inside the 8000 Hz set). Frame sizes 24/48/128 are NOT immediate constants in LPEC.dll: codec framing lives in the container-layer DLLs (STVoice.dll/PVoice.dll CUnitter* classes), so F-47's MSV 16k frame-size question stays open from this pass.

lpec_dll.decode_flow: LPEC::Decode(out_ushort, in_char, count) -> copies input pointer/count into decoder state (offsets +0x538/+0x53c, clears +0x404) -> virtual call vtable+0x14 (bitstream pump) -> FUN_100059e0(wrapper, out) synthesizes PCM; Decode(out, NULL, 0) zero-fills (buffer-bytes/4) shorts = silence path

mode_selection_FUN_1000df10.signature: (state, param_1, param_2) called from engine init FUN_100065b0(state, alloc, param_1, 0, 0, param_2)
mode_selection_FUN_1000df10.param_2_special: 6000 (inside 8000 set: 6000 picks DAT_100388b0/DAT_10038cb0 pair, else DAT_10038cc0/DAT_100390c0)
mode_selection_FUN_1000df10.interpretation: param_1 = sample rate in Hz, param_2 = bitrate in bps; census-level, semantics consistent with F-47 variants (LPEC 6000 bps @ 8 kHz = budgtele/STVoice; ICD-BM1 MSV = the 16000 Hz set)

celp_indicators.meaning: per-frame decode errors report pitch lag and codebook page/grid index - analysis-by-synthesis CELP-family structure

lpec_dll.frame_size_note: immediates 24/48/128/192/384 as imul/mul/lea factors: ZERO hits in all of LPEC.dll - codec frame lengths are computed, not hardcoded; container DLLs own the framing

codebook_inventory.format: per-mode table pointer sets installed at fixed decoder-state offsets; sizes below are address-delta upper bounds (tables may share padding); values are signed 16-bit fixed-point (spot-checked)

container_layer.msvdec_ax_role: DirectShow transform filter CMSVDecryptFilter / IMSVDecrypt; strings 'This is a MSV Format', 'MSVDEC module' - container/transport layer for MSV
container_layer.msvdec_1024_1014_note: const census hits of 1024 and 1014 exist (FUN_100054d0, FUN_10005670) but the 1014 site decompiles as a property-page dialog proc - weak evidence, not confirmatory of the F-47 packet header at this level

codec is CELP-family with fixed-point codebook tables (explains 7.8-7.9 bits/byte dense packing and per-frame comfort-noise structure)
mode selection by (sample rate 8000/16000, bitrate with 6000 special case) matches F-47's LPEC 6000 bps variant arithmetic
